description.p: SLAB6 is a voxel model editor by Ken Silverman, the author of the Build engine. It edits models with a 256 color palette (up to 256x256x255 voxels) and reads and writes the KV6, KVX and VOX formats.
This package is a Linux port of the original Windows source code. The original license applies: free for non-commercial use, with the author's name kept and modified versions marked as modified.
